Hyde Park Winter Wonderland: every visitor needs a booked entry slot

When: Every day from Thursday, November 19, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, except Christmas Day.

Cost: Off-Peak entry slots are free but must still be booked. Standard and Peak slots are paid; check the current price on the official ticket site.

The final day, January 3, 2027, is billed as a Family Fun Day; details were not yet published.

Checked on the official page October 28: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland tickets guide.

ZooLights at Lincoln Park Zoo: four free Monday nights with a reservation

When: Friday, November 20, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, 4:30 to 9 p.m.; last entry 8 p.m.

Cost: Fixed-date tickets USD 7 to USD 12 per person bought in advance, by date; USD 20 bought on the day or for a flexible ticket.

Because infants need a ticket too, count every child when booking a free Monday.
